title: There is a second Sagrada Familia!
text: I did not know what to expect of this tour, but after seeing what I have seen I can only recommend this tour to anyone who visits Barcelona. Guell colony is a treasure, there is something about that Gaudi church that feel more authentic than Sagrada Familia itself.
author: abellarkin

title: Unexpectedly wonderful
text: Just what I wanted. A tour that did not duplicate the usual Barcelona Gaudi tours. Our guide Fred drove us miles and miles and miles. Virtually impossible in less than a day on our own. Included a delicious sandwich and drink at a picturesque local bar and eatery on a picturesque little square in the Barcelona suburb. It included a wonderful tour of the charming suburb of Colonia Guell which I was not expecting.
author: Robert John Axt... W

title: Big help for the Gaudi completist
text: A good option for getting to less-accessible Gaudi sites in Barcelona. Our family saw all seven UNESCO sites in two days thanks to this tour. Audio guides provided information on the Colonia Guell and the surrounding neighborhood and the two other buildings that do not have many tours offered.
author: John_G
